description: This file defines a dataset class for COCO object detection, including data processing functions, transformation pipelines, and a build function to instantiate the dataset based on configuration.

classes.name: CocoDetection
classes.description: A dataset class for COCO detection dataset, extending torchvision's CocoDetection with additional preprocessing.

methods.name: convert_coco_poly_to_mask
